answer: Your ex has to sign the sale documents too, the same as any co-owner. They can come to the appointment with their photo ID, or sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2, which can be signed electronically with no notary (in Georgia it must still be notarized). The exception: if your divorce decree awards the car to you, bring a certified copy of the decree and you won't need your ex's signature. Because your name changed, also bring the document that shows the change (your divorce decree or a court order), and you'll sign the name change affidavit, form NW-NMC-1, at the appointment.
